title: Dasakam 52 — Vatsasteya and the humbling of Brahma
description: Krishna answers Brahma’s test by becoming the calves and cowherd boys, receives their families’ boundless affection, reveals Narayana forms to Brahma, then returns with the restored herd.
translation_note: No vetted stanza translation supplied. English commentary is preserved verbatim from the Facebook group photo captions; canonical Sanskrit and IAST are sourced separately from Stotra Nidhi.

stanzas.sanskrit:
अन्यावतारनिकरेष्वनिरीक्षितं ते
भूमातिरेकमभिवीक्ष्य तदाघमोक्षे ।
ब्रह्मा परीक्षितुमनाः स परोक्षभावं
निन्येऽथ वत्सकगणान् प्रवितत्य मायाम् ॥ ५२-१ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
anyāvatāranikareṣvanirīkṣitaṃ te
bhūmātirekamabhivīkṣya tadāghamokṣe |
brahmā parīkṣitumanāḥ sa parokṣabhāvaṃ
ninye’tha vatsakagaṇān pravitatya māyām || 52-1 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Watching all the glories and majesties of Bhagwan Krishna incarnations especially the salvation of Aghasura, Brahma decided to test Bhagwan and so with his power of Maya, took calves and hid them in an unseen place.

stanzas.sanskrit:
वत्सानवीक्ष्य विवशे पशुपोत्करे ता-
-नानेतुकाम इव धातृमतानुवर्ती ।
त्वं सामिभुक्तकबलो गतवांस्तदानीं
भुक्तांस्तिरोऽधित सरोजभवः कुमारान् ॥ ५२-२ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
vatsānavīkṣya vivaśe paśupotkare tā-
-nānetukāma iva dhātṛmatānuvartī |
tvaṃ sāmibhuktakabalo gatavāṃstadānīṃ
bhuktāṃstiro’dhita sarojabhavaḥ kumārān || 52-2 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Gopas searched for their calves everywhere in the forest and became worried. Krishna, knowing Brahma's plan, in the lookout for calves, Krishna went searching them with half-eaten rice ball in his hand amidst his lunch, making it easy for Brahma, who then made even the cowherd boys disappear and trapped all of them in a cave.

stanzas.sanskrit:
वत्सायितस्तदनु गोपगणायितस्त्वं
शिक्यादिभाण्डमुरलीगवलादिरूपः ।
प्राग्वद्विहृत्य विपिनेषु चिराय सायं
त्वं माययाऽथ बहुधा व्रजमाययाथ ॥ ५२-३ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
vatsāyitastadanu gopagaṇāyitastvaṃ
śikyādibhāṇḍamuralīgavalādirūpaḥ |
prāgvadvihṛtya vipineṣu cirāya sāyaṃ
tvaṃ māyayā’tha bahudhā vrajamāyayātha || 52-3 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna knowing the plans of Brahma, Krishna multiplied himself in to many forms and took the form of each and every Gopa and calves and played in the forest. And in the evening Krishna went back to Vrindavana along with the Gopas and calves.

stanzas.sanskrit:
त्वामेव शिक्यगवलादिमयं दधानो
भूयस्त्वमेव पशुवत्सकबालरूपः ।
गोरूपिणीभिरपि गोपवधूमयीभि-
-रासादितोऽसि जननीभिरतिप्रहर्षात् ॥ ५२-४ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tvāmeva śikyagavalādimayaṃ dadhāno
bhūyastvameva paśuvatsakabālarūpaḥ |
gorūpiṇībhirapi gopavadhūmayībhi-
-rāsādito’si jananībhiratipraharṣāt || 52-4 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: They were so accurate like the original Gopas and calves that even their mothers and cows could not see any difference. Gopikas and cows received the gopa boys and calves with great joy

stanzas.sanskrit:
जीवं हि कञ्चिदभिमानवशात् स्वकीयं
मत्वा तनूज इति रागभरं वहन्त्यः ।
आत्मानमेव तु भवन्तमवाप्य सूनुं
प्रीतिं ययुर्न कियतीं वनिताश्च गावः ॥ ५२-५ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
jīvaṃ hi kañcidabhimānavaśāt svakīyaṃ
matvā tanūja iti rāgabharaṃ vahantyaḥ |
ātmānameva tu bhavantamavāpya sūnuṃ
prītiṃ yayurna kiyatīṃ vanitāśca gāvaḥ || 52-5 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Every life born in this world, which belongs to God is received by the parent, with the assumption that it belongs to them and show love to it. In such a situation, if Paramatma himself goes as a child, then their joy becomes limitless!

stanzas.sanskrit:
एवं प्रतिक्षणविजृम्भितहर्षभार-
-निश्शेषगोपगणलालितभूरिमूर्तिम् ।
त्वामग्रजोऽपि बुबुधे किल वत्सरान्ते
ब्रह्मात्मनोरपि महान् युवयोर्विशेषः ॥ ५२-६ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
evaṃ pratikṣaṇavijṛmbhitaharṣabhāra-
-niśśeṣagopagaṇalālitabhūrimūrtim |
tvāmagrajo’pi bubudhe kila vatsarānte
brahmātmanorapi mahān yuvayorviśeṣaḥ || 52-6 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Day by day, mothers developed more joy with their children. Even Balarama could not make out the difference until a year ended. Though both are brahma swaroopam, still Krishna was unique and special.

stanzas.sanskrit:
वर्षावधौ नवपुरातनवत्सपालान्
दृष्ट्वा विवेकमसृणे द्रुहिणे विमूढे ।
प्रादीदृशः प्रतिनवान् मकुटाङ्गदादि
-भूषांश्चतुर्भुजयुजः सजलाम्बुदाभान् ॥ ५२-७ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
varṣāvadhau navapurātanavatsapālān
dṛṣṭvā vivekamasṛṇe druhiṇe vimūḍhe |
prādīdṛśaḥ pratinavān makuṭāṅgadādi
-bhūṣāṃścaturbhujayujaḥ sajalāmbudābhān || 52-7 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Brahma at the end of the year, came to forest, got confused, seeing the Gopas surrounding Krishna and Balaram and calves grazing happily as before. When Brahma saw them intently, every gopa and calf looked like krishna with four arms adorned with ornaments.

stanzas.sanskrit:
प्रत्येकमेव कमलापरिलालिताङ्गान्
भोगीन्द्रभोगशयनान् नयनाभिरामान् ।
लीलानिमीलितदृशः सनकादियोगि-
-व्यासेवितान् कमलभूर्भवतो ददर्श ॥ ५२-८ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
pratyekameva kamalāparilālitāṅgān
bhogīndrabhogaśayanān nayanābhirāmān |
līlānimīlitadṛśaḥ sanakādiyogi-
-vyāsevitān kamalabhūrbhavato dadarśa || 52-8 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: To Brahma, each one of them were Narayana himself reclining on the snake bed, with Mother Lakshmi massaging his feet, sanakas and sages worshipping him.

stanzas.sanskrit:
नारायणाकृतिमसङ्ख्यतमां निरीक्ष्य
सर्वत्र सेवकमपि स्वमवेक्ष्य धाता ।
मायानिमग्नहृदयो विमुमोह याव-
-देको बभूविथ तदा कबलार्धपाणिः ॥ ५२-९ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
nārāyaṇākṛtimasaṅkhyatamāṃ nirīkṣya
sarvatra sevakamapi svamavekṣya dhātā |
māyānimagnahṛdayo vimumoha yāva-
-deko babhūvitha tadā kabalārdhapāṇiḥ || 52-9 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Brahma's mind was totally confused as he was seeing innumerable forms of Naaraayana everywhere. And then Bhagwan merged all the forms together in to one and stood as Krishna with half eaten rice ball.

stanzas.sanskrit:
नश्यन् मदे तदनु विश्वपतिं मुहुस्त्वां
नत्वा च नूतवति धातरि धाम याते ।
पोतैः समं प्रमुदितैः प्रविशन् निकेतं
वातालयाधिप विभो परिपाहि रोगात् ॥ ५२-१० ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
naśyan made tadanu viśvapatiṃ muhustvāṃ
natvā ca nūtavati dhātari dhāma yāte |
potaiḥ samaṃ pramuditaiḥ praviśan niketaṃ
vātālayādhipa vibho paripāhi rogāt || 52-10 ||
stanzas.commentary_en:
Brahma whose pride was humbled, he bowed down to Bhagwan. He sang Bhagwan’s praises, freed the Gopas and calves. Krishna got back and rejoiced with the Gopas who were unaware of what had happened to them.
Bhattathiri requests Guruvayoorappan to free him from all his ailments!
